title: Fix missing upload button for reels and pictures

requirements.summary: Add a clearly visible upload button accessible from the main navigation or Feed page that navigates authenticated users to the Upload page
acceptanceCriteria: An upload button or icon is visible in the bottom navigation bar or as a floating action button on the Feed, Profile, and Discover pages.
Tapping/clicking the upload button navigates to the /upload route.
The button is only functional when the user is authenticated; unauthenticated users see the AuthGuard login prompt.
The button is present on both mobile (small screens) and desktop layouts.

file_operations.description: Add an upload button/icon to the bottom navigation bar (primaryNavItems or secondaryNavItems array) that routes to /upload. The button must use the Plus or Upload icon from lucide-react and include responsive styling for both mobile and desktop layouts. Ensure the navigation item is visible and tappable on all screen sizes.

requirements.summary: Verify and fix the Upload page so that users can successfully upload both video and image files with proper file input, submit button visibility, and chunked upload completion
acceptanceCriteria: The Upload page renders a file picker that accepts video/* and image/* MIME types.
A submit/upload button is visible on the Upload page and becomes enabled once a file, title, and category are provided.
Selecting a video file and submitting triggers the chunked upload progress indicator and completes successfully.
Selecting an image/photo file and submitting completes successfully.
On successful upload the user is navigated to the feed and the new post appears.

file_operations.description: Review and fix the Upload page to ensure: (1) the file input accept attribute includes both video/* and image/* MIME types; (2) the submit/upload button is visible and properly styled, with disabled state controlled by form validation (file selected, title and category provided); (3) the chunked upload progress indicator displays correctly during upload; (4) successful uploads navigate to /feed and the new video/photo appears in the feed. Preserve the existing chunked upload logic using ExternalBlob.fromBytes().withUploadProgress() as documented in the blob-storage component usage instructions. Verify that the form fields (title, description, category, hashtags, thumbnail) are wired correctly and that the createVideo mutation is called with the proper ExternalBlob instance.
